acceptanceCriteria.description: A reviewer confirms eligibility, unchanged candidate/revision/contract, retained failed evidence, independent verification, fresh approval, and recovery states against current source. Evidence: Exact candidate SHA, separate verifier Attempt and semantic review evidence
acceptanceCriteria.title: The runbook accurately explains verification retries

acceptanceCriteria.description: After a controlled restart, candidate SHA and evidence remain unchanged and the completed producer is not dispatched again. Evidence: Before/after worker session IDs, canonical Attempt states and inference receipts
acceptanceCriteria.title: Worker restart preserves evidence without producer replay

acceptanceCriteria.description: The approved candidate is published as a draft PR; no merge occurs. Evidence: Human publication decision, GitHub draft flag, branch/head SHA and PR URL
acceptanceCriteria.title: Publication ends at a draft PR with human approval

constraints: Total program cap $5; qualification reserves $0.51 and this Mission reserves $4.49
Do not infer approval or successful verification from component qualification
No merge, deployment, automatic retry or unrelated changes
Component qualification is not canonical verification or approval
desiredOutcome: Write only docs/operations/verification-retry-runbook.md, with accurate retry prerequisites, evidence retention, independent verification, fresh approval and failure/recovery instructions.

allowedCommands: Run the frozen independent documentation check

args: const fs=require('fs');const p='docs/operations/verification-retry-runbook.md';const s=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');for(const r of [/NOT_VERIFIED/,/BLOCKED/,/candidate/i,/revision/i,/contract/i,/evidence/i,/approval/i,/restart/i])if(!r.test(s))throw Error('Missing required topic: '+r);if(s.split('\n').length>300)throw Error('Runbook exceeds 300 lines');if(/\b(TODO|TBD|PLACEHOLDER)\b/.test(s))throw Error('Unfinished content');console.log('Required runbook topics present; semantic review remains required');

implementationPolicy.stopCondition: Stop after candidate capture for independent verification; block on unknown cost, stale authority or exhausted budget.

planApprovalRequirements: Human approval of the exact candidate before draft publication
metadata.rollbackApproach: Stop execution, revoke any live credential, retain evidence and the candidate branch, and close an unwanted draft PR only on operator instruction. Never merge.
